mappings.visualRationale: Visibly shows a muscular arm and clenched fist flexing against an explosive, radiating golden-orange power burst aura, clearly depicting physical empowerment and a melee damage buff (+1d4 on attacks) for nearby allies.

Visibly shows a mystical figure manipulating a glowing, intertwined spiral thread of golden energy linked to another humanoid engulfed in radiant aura, capturing the twisting of a creature's golden threads of fate and severing their luck tokens.

Visibly shows a massive warhammer striking downward with tremendous force, creating a luminous electric-blue shockwave impact and shattering debris, perfectly portraying the lightning-like 2d6 hammer strike.
Visibly shows a clouded, milky-white pupil-less eye veiled within bruised violet eyelids, cleanly depicting a target suffering from acute magical blindness.
